articles.title: Verizon posts worst day since 2002 as SpaceX U.S. network plans whack cell provider stocks
articles.summary: Telecommunications stocks sold off on Friday after Elon Musk's SpaceX announced an agreement to purchase a nationwide spectrum portfolio, aiming to expand its Starlink internet into mobile service. Shares of T-Mobile dropped 13.27% while AT&T fell 9.81%, each notching their own worst days since 2013 and 2000, respectively. SpaceX stock climbed slightly, around 1% for the day.

articles.title: Tanker attacks in Strait of Hormuz surge to wartime high as Iran tries to choke off oil exports
articles.summary: Oil tankers transiting the Strait of Hormuz are coming under fire almost daily, as Iran escalates its attacks in an effort to choke off a rebound in crude exports. The surge of attacks on tankers comes as crude oil exports from the Middle East rebounded in September to prewar levels, due in large part to the U.S. "This is not a sustainable new normal," said Richard Meade, editor in chief of the shipping industry trade journal Lloyd's List, in a Thursday briefing.
